tasks.subject: Investigate hidden-window CPU usage
tasks.description: Find why app CPU usage rises when hidden to tray/menu and drops when shown. Inspect eframe/egui tray integration, repaint loop, worker/background timers, logging, and Windows-specific event handling. Report root cause and targeted fix.

tasks.subject: Fix hidden-window CPU usage
tasks.description: Modify tray hide/show flow to avoid hidden repaint loop, preserve reliable tray restore, remove risky state mismatch, then format and verify with cargo commands. Acceptance: hidden app schedules no egui repaint timer; tray click restores window reliably; code compiles and clippy passes where environment allows.
